_readme: FIAT GEAR - the new items, in one go: the builds pass's uniques, the five sets' pieces, the melee weapons, the small melee and the melee parts (grips and heads) - every job from uniques, sets, melee, melee_small, melee_parts whose art/items/<slug>.png was not on disk when this was generated. 53 jobs.

Run: godot --headless --script res://tools/pixellab_batch_v2.gd ++ --manifest res://tools/pixellab_items_new_manifest.json   (++ --dry-run to list). Rides art/reference/items/ref_01..04.png as style like the rest of the pool. A job whose file exists is skipped; one that came out wrong: ++ --only <slug> ++ --force.
Regenerate with python3 tools/make_item_manifests.py on the machine that holds the art, so the 'exists' test sees the real folder; the per-group manifests are the same jobs grouped.
